title: Restriction assignment weight at half
statement: For any natural number $n$ and any assignment of one of the three states “free,” “fixed to $1$,” or “fixed to $-1$” to each of the $n$ coordinates, its product weight at parameter $ rac12$ equals its ordinary product weight, where the ordinary coordinate weights are $ rac12$ for a free coordinate and $ rac14$ for either fixed coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state is assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
